quarterly_data.quarter: Alfa Laval press release: Alfa Laval selected by Saipem to supply heat transfer (09-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Order (release): Alfa Laval was selected by Saipem, the EPC contractor for Stockholm Exergi's BECCS (bioenergy with carbon capture and storage) project, to supply heat transfer equipment - its Ziepack gas-gas interchanger plus multiple process plate-and-frame heat exchangers, part of the core capture process - for one of Europe's largest bioenergy carbon capture facilities, at Europe's largest biomass-based combined heat and power plant in Stockholm. The project is expected to begin operations in 2028 and to capture, liquefy and permanently store up to 800,000 tonnes of CO2 annually.
quarterly_data.figure: operations from 2028; up to 800,000 tonnes of CO2 a year
